name: Setup Rust and Cargo
description: Sets up Rust by installing a toolchain/components/targets with rustup, and also Cargo by installing bins and caching core.

bins.description: Comma-separated list of global binaries to install into Cargo.

cache-base.description: Base branch/ref to save a warmup cache on. Other branches/refs will restore from this base.

cache-target.description: Name of the target profile to cache.

cache-extra-identifier.description: Additional identifier to include in cache key for matrix jobs or custom cache separation.

components.description: Comma-separated list of additional components to install.

inherit-toolchain.description: Inherit all toolchain settings from the rust-toolchain.toml file.

targets.description: Comma-separated list of additional targets to install.

target-dirs.description: Comma-separated list of target folder paths, relative from the repository root.
